plugins.name: loom-workflow
plugins.description: Optional using-loom-workflow discovery routing and Loom workflow tools around the loom stations — persistent Outcome Maps, git memory, loom-memory (recall / record / reconcile / retire durable repository lessons), critique (proposal | complexity), recap, handoff, session distill, CoT explainers, cross-executor second opinion, plus the standalone goal-create and dbt-model-style skills.

plugins.name: loom-code
plugins.description: Optional using-loom-code discovery routing and five stations carry one change from plan to PR with non-blocking cross-vendor suggestions, content-bound verification, one closing review, and a fast publication gate. Claude Code + Codex.

plugins.name: loom-design
plugins.description: Optional using-loom-design discovery routing and two stations — capture-intent, write-spec — turn a rough idea into a confirmed intent and a risk-declared spec, route non-blocking second-vendor suggestions, and provide product-principles and design-system tools. Reads loom-code's contract package. Claude Code + Codex.
